name: table-360-only-flow
title: Simplify tables to a 360-only visual flow
description: Upgrade the add-table modal and remove per-table 3D/AR placement so each table exposes only photo/360 viewing.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The backend Table position remains required for the manually designed floor map. The change removes all reachable callers that attach visualConfig or AR-derived coordinates to a table, while keeping vrUrl/photos and legacy backend fields for backward compatibility.
